when: evaluate at day 7 after each completed contact
flag_if: (a) predicted disengagement probability at the contact is at or above the 20% threshold (thresholds.json) or the points score is in its top 20%
(b) no completed contact and no logged attempt (EncounterNote with encounterOccurred = 'NO') in days 1 to 7
order_list_by: predicted return if attempted from the uplift model (uplift_*.joblib), highest first; do not use it to exclude patients
monitoring: monthly realized disengagement by predicted decile; flag rate and sensitivity by state and by race and ethnicity; refit quarterly
